title: Pure Chimera
match: Gazelle the King of Mythical Beasts
summary: The 2023 Chimera engine: Chimera Fusion and the Beasts, Fiends and Illusions that name it, with generic Links and staples. Big-Winged Berfomet searches a Level 4 Beast and Chimera Fusion. Mirror Swordknight tributes itself to summon a monster that mentions Chimera Fusion from the Deck, and Cornfield Coatl discards to search one. Chimera Fusion fuses on either Main Phase using a Beast or Fiend. Once Chimera the Flying Mythical Beast is on the field or in the GY, it returns to the hand or summons Gazelle and Berfomet from the Deck. Chimera the King of Phantom Beasts and Berfomet the Mythical King both count as Chimera the Flying Mythical Beast and revive a monster from the GY on the opponent's turn. Chimera the Illusion Beast attacks once per material. While Chimera is out, Swordknight and Coatl negate from the GY. Big-Winged Berfomet limits the Extra Deck to Fusions for the turn.
